svg.title: How requests move through the skill collection
svg.desc: A vertical routing flow. Clear requests go directly to a specialist. Broad or cross-domain requests use one domain entry point. One primary owner follows the shortest safe path, verifies only the claims it makes, and returns an evidence-backed result.
